title: System Control Board 3e: each crawler run opens to the records it touched; "W1 today"
why: A cleanup fix folded into the board (Jason, 2026-11-18: 'yes queue the crawler run records fix'; 'clean up fixes that touch the system should move into the system board session'), on the ledger of decisions/0171 §4 (release 2a, control_ledger and control_records). Insights → Crawler: (1) each of the last runs links to its page (with how many records it touched): a record page with the command strip (decisions/0129), what each task did, and its records under their workflow, grouped Added, Changed (the fields), Sent to Review and Refused (a field a person entered kept, and it says so); each count narrows the list; each record opens in a Peek (a listing, a Review item). (2) 'What a workflow touched': a workflow and a day (today, yesterday, the last 7 days; UTC) list its records by kind and by run. No new table: the run comes from control_ledger.run_id, the workflow from the endpoint (the register). Only what the ledger keeps is shown: record numbers and field names, never values before and after (0171 §4: ids and counts only). Tests: r3e.php 12 (new); rendered at 390px. Built on Sync 21:45 UTC (3d, #144, live).

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
